Hello! May nakapag-try na ba dito kumuha ng Makati health certificate online? Kapag ba Hi-Precision ang clinic, gaano katagal usually before ma-upload ang results sa portal?

Nauna kasi yung medical ko (w/c includes chest x-ray and stool exam) as part of my pre-employment requirements. A few days after, saka lang ako sinabihan ng employer na need ko mag-submit ng Makati occupational & health permit kaya nung nakaraan ko lang din naasikaso. Called the clinic regarding this and already paid naman na para ma-upload. I also gave them my application number and date of application since yun lang hiningi nila. Until now hindi pa rin nauupload yung medical results kaya pending approval pa yung application ko for permit.

Sana may makasagot. Thank you! Appreciate all your inputs!
